tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Remaining all other terms and conditions are as per the attached Tender Document.

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Anubandha 04- Acceptance of Tender Terms and Conditions
Attested copy of Authorized Dealership Certificate
Attested copy of GST Registration Certificate
Attested copy of PAN Card and Income Tax Returns Certificate for last 3 years
Attested copy of Valid Trade License Certificate -within the Udupi District
Certificate regarding the satisfactory completion of street light supply and maintenance works during the preceding two years
Consolidated Annual Turnover Certificate attested by CA with UDIN Number for the last 3 years- Annual Turnover should not be a less than Tender Amount

Declaration by the notary, about 1. Non-Elected member and 2. Not black listed firm in any of the Government departments /authorities/PSUs/Local Bodies - Submit on through Rs.100/- stamp/e-stamping paper
GST Returns Certificate for last 3 month and clearance certificate for last 3 years
The Tenderer shall mandatorily obtain a Site Inspection Report from the Gram Panchayat Development Officer confirming that the site has been inspected
The Tenderer shall submit documentary proof to establish that the firm/agency is located within the jurisdiction of Dakshina Kannada District.
